qualityRule: Null/absent means unavailable. Missing environmental values never default to GREEN.

bom.note: Supply BOM Climate Data Online daily/hourly CSV export. Public free historical data are downloadable, but extraction/download URLs are not durable and sub-daily archive extraction may require a data request.

waternsw.note: Supply WaterInsights/WaterNSW 15-minute export or configured keyed API URL. API access requires a subscription key.

beachwatch.note: Supply Beachwatch historical water-quality export. Turbidity is consumed only if explicitly present.

imos.note: Supply IMOS/BOM marine point extraction for the six pilot sites.

incidents.note: Supply Taronga ASID / DPI export or API response. Public-report seeds are no longer treated as empirical incident records.
